mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.5%, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns due to compressed discount rates in a low-rate environment.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% (over a 3-year rolling window), or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI (CPIAUCSL) rises above 225, it signals persistent inflation that prompts central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 225 (over a 3-year rolling window), or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.5% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is above 225, it indicates a 'stagflation' scenario where low rates fail to stimulate growth due to high inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5 AND CPIAUCSL > 225 (over a 3-year rolling window), or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 8.0%, it indicates a labor market slowdown that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0 (over a 3-year rolling window), or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 650.0, it signals a weakening real estate market that reduces consumer wealth and confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 40% of instances when HOUST < 650.0 (over a 3-year rolling window), or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 94.0, it indicates a contraction in the manufacturing sector that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 94.0 (over a 3-year rolling window), or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer spending (RSAFS) is below 390000.0 million dollars and inflation (CPIAUCSL) is above 225, it indicates a weak consumer sector under high inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when RSAFS < 390000.0 AND CPIAUCSL > 225 (over a 3-year rolling window), or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) falls below 13300.0 billion, it signals a recessionary risk that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 40% of instances when GDPC1 < 13300.0 (over a 3-year rolling window), or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
